topics.title: Arrays & Two-Pointer Invariants
topics.description: In-place sliding window, two-pointers, and prefix sum arrays.
topics.conceptContent: Arrays store contiguous elements in memory. Two-pointer technique maintains two indices moving towards each other or at varying speeds.
topics.syntaxCheatsheet:
left, right = 0, len(nums) - 1
while left < right:
    curr = nums[left] + nums[right]
    if curr == target: return [left, right]
    elif curr < target: left += 1
    else: right -= 1
commonMistakes: Off-by-one boundary checking
Forgetting sorted array prerequisite for two pointers

topics.title: Dynamic Programming & Memoization
topics.description: Breaking problems into overlapping subproblems with memoized lookup tables.
topics.conceptContent: Dynamic Programming optimizes recursion by storing calculated subproblem results in a table.
commonMistakes: Missing base cases causing recursion overflow
Exponential time complexity without memoization table

topics.description: In-place sliding window, two-pointers, and prefix sum arrays.
topics.conceptContent: Arrays store contiguous elements in memory. Two-pointer technique maintains two indices moving towards each other or at varying speeds.

    if curr == target: return [left, right]
    elif curr < target: left += 1
    else: right -= 1
